dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 25, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
HOT STOVE HEATS UP ACROSS MLB

A thrilling day of action across the league saw some standout performances from hitters and pitchers alike. In the Kansas City Royals' 3-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, Carter Jensen and Salvador Perez led the charge with crucial hits, while Hao-Yu Lee's 2-for-4 outing included a home run and two RBI. Meanwhile, Alex Lange picked up the save with a strong 1.0 inning of work.

In a lopsided 9-2 win for the San Francisco Giants over the Los Angeles Angels, Rafael Devers went 3-for-4 with a home run and four RBI, while Robbie Ray dominated on the mound with six scoreless innings. Dylan Cease threw a complete game shutout in the Toronto Blue Jays' 6-0 victory over the Boston Red Sox, striking out 12 batters.

The Chicago Cubs' 11-0 thrashing of the Pittsburgh Pirates was highlighted by Pete Crow-Armstrong's 4-for-5 performance, including a home run and three RBI. Paul Skenes led the Cubs' pitching staff with 11 strikeouts in 5.1 innings, despite ultimately taking the loss.
